newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end up slightly.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed a shade higher on Thursday after crawling in a tight range as buyers were stymied by a lack of selling ahead of holidays later this month and foreign investors kept a low profile, brokers said.
The all share index closed 1.27 points up at 640.7 with gainers edging out losers 25 to 18. Ceylon Tobacco rose one rupee to 35, Hatton National Bank two to 245.
"There are enough local buyers and sellers to support the market, but they cannot decide on the price levels at which they want to trade," said Shafi Waheed, a trader at CDIC Sasoon Cumberbatch.
